contentHtml:
Pixelating picture, missing channels, or a screen that freezes every time the wind picks up? That is almost always the antenna, not the TV. I install, repair and maintain digital TV antennas around Stretton and Brisbane, so you get Channels 7, 9, 10 and the rest back in sharp digital quality.

Usually the antenna, not the telly

A lot of the antennas I replace are over 25 years old and were never set up for digital TV in the first place. When the picture pixelates, drops channels or freezes, people blame the television and go shopping for a new one. Nine times out of ten the money is far better spent fixing what is on the roof. Years of storms, sun and heat wear rooftop aerials out, so a tired antenna is a common cause of poor reception.

What I do

  • New antenna installs, the right aerial for your area, mounted and aligned for a strong, stable signal.
  • Aerial repairs and realignment, often all a poor picture needs, without a full replacement.
  • Extra TV points, so you can watch in another room without a mess of cables.
  • Free-to-air, no subscriptions, all the standard channels in clear digital quality with nothing ongoing to pay.

Once the reception is sorted, I can set up the TV and apps too, see my smart TV and streaming setup service.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
